armies_of_renown.name: Gorechosen Champions
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Blades of Khorne faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Gorechosen Champions Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Blades of Khorne faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
0-1 Mighty Lord of Khorne (if included, must be general)
Any Slaughterpriests
Any Bloodsecrators
Any Bloodstokers
Any Realmgore Ritualists
Any Skullgrinders
Any Deathbringers
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
REGIMENT OPTIONS
Any Bloodbound Warmongers can be added to a regiment led by a GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS unit

battle_traits.name: Murder-won Trophies
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Gorechosen Champions' Army of Renown rules.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: This artefact of power is given to the HERO during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

battle_traits.name: Brutal Lashmaster
battle_traits.effect: Each time a friendly Bloodstoker uses the 'Whipped to Fury' ability, another friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit.

battle_traits.name: Legendary Slayers
battle_traits.effect: Blood-hungry weapons used by friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have Crit (Mortal).

battle_traits.name: The Red God's Eye
battle_traits.effect: Friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units have WARD (6+)

battle_traits.name: Hate-fuelled Killers
battle_traits.effect: The first time each friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (1) that unit.

entries.name: Crowned in Butchery
entries.effect: Add 20 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

entries.name: Warmonger's Icon
entries.declare: Pick this unit and up to D3 friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
entries.effect: The targets have STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: The Scarring Blade
entries.effect:
Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add X to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS units, where X is equal to the number of damage points allocated to this unit this turn by this ability.
For the rest of the battle, this unit cannot use the 'Hate-fuelled Killers' ability and cannot be healed.

entries.name: Bloodmist Skull
entries.effect: This unit has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

entries.name: Summon Wrath-axe
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Skin of Brass
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Cowed and Broken
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visibleenemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll 8 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to each roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.name: Eruption of Apoplexy
entries.declare: Pick a friendly GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. If the target is destroyed, before removing the last model in that unit from play, inflict D3 mortal damage on every unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of that model, or D6 mortal damage instead of the chanting roll was 8+.

armies_of_renown.name: The Baleful Lords
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Blades of Khorne faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Baleful Lords Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Blades of Khorne faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the BALEFUL LORDS keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Any BLADES OF KHORNE MONSTER HERO DAEMON units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Born of Butchery
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BALEFUL LORDS unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Bellow of Hatred
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly Baleful Lords unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use RAMPAGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Mage-eaters
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
battle_traits.effect: Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, the spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

battle_traits.name: First in His Sight
battle_traits.effect: Heal (D3) each friendly BALEFUL LORDS HERO that is in combat.

battle_traits.name: Drawn by Blood
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that has not used a RAMPAGE ability this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect:
That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.
If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:
That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.

battle_traits.name: The Price of Mercy
battle_traits.declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit that did not charge or use a FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

battle_traits.name: Sunder the Sorcerous
battle_traits.declare: Pick each enemy MANIFESTATION within 3" of a friendly BALEFUL LORDS unit to be a target.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
• That target is banished and removed from play.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.

entries.name: Unrivalled Battlelust
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly BALEFUL LORDS units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Crown of the Slaughterborn
entries.effect: Enemy units within 12" of this unit cannot be healed and cannot have slain models returned to them.
